anomalies.description: A man in a white shirt points a gun at two others (one adult male, one child) who are crouching or recoiling; the scene shows an aggressive confrontation with physical threat, but no mutual combat yet.
A man in a dark coat is seen forcefully grabbing and pulling a young girl by the arm/shoulder; she appears distressed and unable to resist.
A man in a white shirt and suspenders aims and fires a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at t=5.0, and the recoil and posture confirm discharge.
A sudden blast occurs near a van and display pedestal, producing a large cloud of smoke/dust and debris; the statue on the pedestal is knocked over and shattered.
A man in a white shirt fires a handgun, producing a visible muzzle flash and smoke; he is thrown backward by the recoil or impact.

Two men are engaged in close physical combat: one bald man in a suit is grabbing or striking another man’s head/neck area; motion blur indicates rapid movement and contact.; A man in a black suit is actively grappling with another man, lifting or throwing him; visible hand placement on the opponent’s torso and dynamic posture indicate mutual physical struggle.
A man in a white chef-style jacket aims and fires a handgun toward a display case; his stance, arm extension, and focus confirm active shooting.

A man in a dark suit is shown aiming and firing a handgun; muzzle flash is not visible but the sustained aiming posture, finger on trigger, and recoil motion across frames f11–f15 confirm a shooting action.

In the aftermath of the shooting, multiple men in tuxedos are seen reacting violently: one falls backward (f14), another raises a weapon (f15), and a third appears to be struck or ducking (f14–f15), indicating mutual physical combat or retaliatory exchange.
A man in a black suit aims and fires a handgun; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel tip in frame f3 (57.5s), indicating discharge.
A bald man in a dark suit peeks from behind a wall and fires a handgun; a bright muzzle flash is visible at the barrel in frame f7 (59.5s).
A sudden blast occurs, evidenced by dense smoke filling the frame immediately after the gunshot, consistent with an explosion triggered by the shot (e.g., detonation of nearby explosives).
A man fires a handgun; muzzle flash and smoke are visible as he recoils from the shot.
